description: Base token safety check for one ERC-20 contract: proxy/upgradeable, owner and whether it is renounced, mint, blacklist, pause, fee/tax and limit switches found in the bytecode, DEX liquidity, pair age and 24 h buys/sells, risk flags, a 0-100 score and a grade A-F. Paid per call. Price: 10 sats or US$0.01 (USDC) per call.

l402.description: Optional. After paying the Lightning invoice: '<token>:<preimage>'.

pass.description: Optional. A Diamond budget token (dp_...) that your user approved once (from US$0.89; USDC or other Base tokens, or Lightning) or that you funded with the free diamond_budget tool. Each call deducts its price; no wallet needed in the agent.

pay_with.description: Optional. 'lightning' returns a BOLT11 invoice and a token instead of the x402 payment request.

token.description: ERC-20 token contract address on Base (0x + 40 hex characters)

name: base_token_check
title: Base token safety check
